Fieldwork

Public health starts on your street.

FIELDWORK by Earth5R takes students into their own neighbourhoods to work with the community on waste and the local environment, with a mentor checking the work as it goes. The conditions behind the statistics are usually a short walk away.

Learn more at earth5r.org
jobs_ad_html: Fieldwork Heading for medicine or public health? FIELDWORK by Earth5R is a mentored fellowship where school and university students study real problems in their neighbourhood with the community, and every piece of work is verified. earth5r.org/fieldwork
jobs_intro: Healthcare and pharma roles checked today, health tech included. Every listing links to the original posting. No referral needed, for once.
